init.title: Venice AI Options
init.description: Configure Venice AI settings. Only models with function calling support are shown.

data_description.chat_model: Chat model used for conversation. Only models that support function calling are listed.
data_description.prompt: Instructions sent with every conversation. Home Assistant adds entity state and tool instructions.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Home Assistant APIs this assistant may use to control devices. Leave empty to disable control.
data_description.temperature: Higher values make replies more varied. Range 0 to 2.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum tokens in a single reply. Range 1 to 32768.
data_description.strip_thinking_response: Remove reasoning text from the spoken or displayed reply.
data_description.disable_thinking: Ask reasoning models not to use a thinking step.
data_description.max_tool_iterations: How many tool calls one turn may make. Range 1 to 20.
data_description.tts_model_voice: Speech model and voice, shown as model then voice.
data_description.stt_timestamps: Include word timestamps when the model supports them.
data_description.stream_response: Stream the reply as it is generated instead of waiting for the full response.
